lore: Archer (Japanese: アポロ  Apollo ) is one of the Team Rocket  Executives introduced in Pokémon Gold and Silver . He was not given an official name or design to distingush him from the other male Executives until Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver .

title: Red Gyarados
lore: The red Gyarados (Japanese: あかいギャラドス  Red Gyarados ) is a term used to refer to a Gyarados that is Shiny , which is red rather than its usual blue. According to Pokémon the Series , this is due to the forced Evolution ; the Magikarp it evolves from retains its red color, having no time to change its scale color to blue. Unlike most Shiny Pokémon, the red Gyarados's existence is canon in that it is encountered as part of an event in the Generation II games and their remakes .

title: Janine
lore: Janine (Japanese: アンズ  Anzu ) is the Gym Leader of Fuchsia City 's Gym , known officially as the Fuchsia Gym . She became a Gym Leader after her father, Koga , was promoted to the Elite Four in Generation II . She specializes in Poison-type  Pokémon . She gives the Soul Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle .

title: Karen
lore: Karen (Japanese: カリン  Karin ) is a Dark-type  Trainer and member of the Indigo  Elite Four . She bears a striking resemblance to Sanqua , but the relationship between the two, if any, is unknown. [ 4 ]

title: Will
lore: Will (Japanese: イツキ  Itsuki ) is a Psychic-type  Trainer and member of the Indigo  Elite Four .

title: Clair
lore: Clair (Japanese: イブキ  Ibuki ) is the Gym Leader of Blackthorn City 's Gym , known officially as the Blackthorn Gym . She specializes in Dragon-type  Pokémon , and she gives the Rising Badge to Trainers who defeat her. Her cousin is Lance .

title: Pryce
lore: Pryce (Japanese: ヤナギ  Yanagi ) is the Gym Leader of Mahogany Town 's Gym , known officially as the Mahogany Gym . He is an expert in Ice-type  Pokémon . He gives the Glacier Badge to Trainers who defeat him at his Gym.

title: Jasmine
lore: Jasmine (Japanese: ミカン  Mikan ) is the Gym Leader of Olivine City 's Gym , known officially as the Olivine Gym . She specializes in Steel-type  Pokémon , and she gives the Mineral Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle . She also appears in Sinnoh to give Trainers HM07 ( Waterfall ) and to compete in Sinnoh's Super Contests .

title: Chuck
lore: Chuck (Japanese: シジマ  Shijima ) is the Gym Leader of Cianwood City 's Gym , officially known as the Cianwood Gym . He specializes in Fighting-type  Pokémon . Chuck gives out the Storm Badge to Trainers who defeat him.

title: Morty
lore: Morty (Japanese: マツバ  Matsuba ) is the Gym Leader of Ecruteak City 's Gym , known officially as the Ecruteak Gym . He hands out the Fog Badge to Trainers who defeat him. He specializes in Ghost-type  Pokémon .

title: Whitney
lore: Whitney (Japanese: アカネ  Akane ) is the Gym Leader of Goldenrod City 's Gym , known officially as the Goldenrod Gym . She hands out the Plain Badge to Trainers who defeat her. She specializes in Normal-type  Pokémon .

title: Bugsy
lore: Bugsy (Japanese: ツクシ  Tsukushi ) is the Gym Leader of Azalea Town 's Gym , known officially as the Azalea Gym . He hands out the Hive Badge to Trainers who defeat him. He specializes in Bug-type  Pokémon .

title: Falkner
lore: Falkner (Japanese: ハヤト  Hayato ) is the Gym Leader of Violet City 's Gym , known officially as the Violet Gym . He hands out the Zephyr Badge to Trainers who defeat him. He specializes in Flying-type  Pokémon .

title: Mr. Pokémon
lore: Mr. Pokémon (Japanese: ポケモンじいさん  Old Man Pokémon ) is a non-player character who lives in a house on Route 30 in the Johto  region . He casually researches Pokémon findings as a hobby, and is old friends with Professor Oak . He keeps in contact with Professor Elm , as Elm is the authority on Pokémon Evolution .

title: Professor Elm
lore: Professor Elm (Japanese: ウツギ博士  Dr. Utsugi ) is the resident Pokémon Professor of New Bark Town in the Johto region. He specializes in Pokémon breeding , and is credited with the discovery of Pokémon Eggs . According to Professor Oak , in HeartGold and SoulSilver , Professor Elm "is the best when it comes to the research of Pokémon evolution ." In the Pokémon animated series , Elm also states he studies unusual Pokémon Abilities . Elm gives one of the three first partner Pokémon of Johto— Chikorita , Cyndaquil , and Totodile —to Ethan , Kris C , or Lyra HG SS so that they will have an easier time getting to Mr. Pokémon 's house.

title: Silver (game)
lore: Silver (Japanese: シルバー  Silver ) is the rival character of Pokémon Gold, Silver , and Crystal and Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver , playing opposite Ethan , Kris , or Lyra . He is the son of Team Rocket Boss Giovanni . In Generation II , he appears with no Trainer class in all battles, although the Rival (Japanese: ライバル  Rival ) Trainer class is associated with him in the game data. In Generation IV , he uses the same Trainer class, except this time it appears normally in-game.

title: Ethan (game)
lore: Ethan (Japanese: ヒビキ  Hibiki ) is the main playable character in Pokémon Gold and Silver and is the male choice in Pokémon Crystal , Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver . In Crystal, his female counterpart is Kris , while in HeartGold and SoulSilver, his female counterpart is Lyra .

title: Todd Snap
lore: Todd Snap (Japanese: トオル  Toru ) is a professional Pokémon  photographer . Making his debut in the animated series , he is most notable as the player character of Pokémon Snap .

title: Tomoaki Imakuni
lore: Tomoaki Imakuni (Japanese: 今国智章  Imakuni Tomoaki ), usually referred to as Imakuni? ( イマクニ？  Imakuni? ), is a staff member at Creatures, Inc. involved in various aspects of the TCG , including illustrations and other appearances on several cards. [ 1 ] Imakuni is known as an eccentric musician who performed some of the music for Pokémon the Series . Imakuni? played a small part in the designing of Pokémon Ranger and its sequel, Shadows of Almia . He is in the band Suzukisan . He is also credited as the author of the Pokémon Tales picture book " Come Out, Squirtle! ". Additionally, Imakuni? starred in his own card game titled Bakaboom : Composition Game So Hard Your Brain Will Spill Out . [ 2 ]

title: Tsunekazu Ishihara
lore: Tsunekazu Ishihara ( Tsunekaz also seen; Japanese: 石原恒和  Ishihara Tsunekazu , born November 27, 1957) is the president and CEO of The Pokémon Company , a producer of Pokémon , and the founder and former CEO of Creatures, Inc. He manages all aspects of the Pokémon franchise including the animated series , games , and the Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Rod (TCG GB)
lore: Rod (Japanese: リュウドー  Ryūdō ) is the fourth Grand Master . He plays using the Legendary Dragonite Deck (Japanese: でんせつのドラゴンデッキ  Legendary Dragon Deck ). In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the だいドラゴンデッキ  Great Dragon Deck .

title: Jack (TCG GB)
lore: Jack (Japanese: カネコウジ  Kanekōji ) is the third Grand Master . He plays using the Legendary Articuno Deck (Japanese: でんせつのフリーザーデッキ  Legendary Freezer Deck ). In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the ウォーターレジェンドデッキ  Water Legend Deck .

title: Steve (TCG GB)
lore: Steve (Japanese: スティーブ  Steve ) is the second Grand Master .  He plays using the Legendary Zapdos Deck (Japanese: でんせつのサンダーデッキ  Legendary Thunder Deck ).  In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the でんせつのかせきデッキ  Legendary Fossil Deck .

title: Courtney (TCG GB)
lore: Courtney (Japanese: ヒロコ  Hiroko ) is the first Grand Master .  She plays using the Legendary Moltres Deck (Japanese: でんせつのファイアーデッキ  Legendary Fire Deck ).  In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , she uses the グランドファイヤーデッキ  Grand Fire Deck .

title: Michael (TCG GB)
lore: Michael (Japanese: マサヒロ  Masahiro ) is one of the three Club Members from the Fighting Club , under Club Master  Mitch , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Jessica (TCG GB)
lore: Jessica (Japanese: ナツキ  Natsuki ) is one of the three Club Members from the Fighting Club , under Club Master  Mitch , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Chris (TCG GB)
lore: Chris (Japanese: タツロー  Tatsurō ) is one of the three Club Members from the Fighting Club , under Club Master  Mitch , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Mitch (TCG GB)
lore: Mitch (Japanese: ヤマグチ  Yamaguchi ) is the Club Master of the Fighting Club (Japanese: バトルクラブ  Battle Club ). He plays using the First-Strike Deck (Japanese: せんせいこうげきデッキ  Preemptive Hit Deck ) and gives away the Fighting Medal to challengers who defeat him. In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the ドトウのてっけんデッキ  Iron Fist of the Billows Deck . His Fighting Club is a dojo filled with weight training equipment.

title: Ryan (TCG GB)
lore: Ryan (Japanese: ノリオ  Norio ) is one of the three Club Members from the Rock Club , under Club Master  Gene , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Matthew (TCG GB)
lore: Matthew (Japanese: ヤストモ  Yasutomo ) is one of the three Club Members from the Rock Club , under Club Master  Gene , in the Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Andrew (TCG GB)
lore: Andrew (Japanese: ジョータ  Jōta ) is one of the three Club Members from the Rock Club , under Club Master  Gene , in Pokémon Trading Card Game and Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! .

title: Gene (TCG GB)
lore: Gene (Japanese: ゲンゾウ  Genzō ) is the Club Master of the Rock Club (Japanese: ストーンクラブ  Stone Club ).  He plays using the Rock Crusher Deck (Japanese: がんせきおとしデッキ  Rock Tumble Deck ) and gives away the Rock Medal to challengers who defeat him. In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the いわのうえにも３ねんデッキ  Even 3 Years on a Rock Deck . He admires Rock-type Pokémon for being hard and strong. He believes that they won't crumble under pressure. He calls weaklings "softies". The Rock Club appears to be filled with sand and stone statues.

title: Stephanie (TCG GB)
lore: Stephanie (Japanese: リエ  Rie ) is one of the three Club Members from the Psychic Club , under Club Master  Murray , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Robert (TCG GB)
lore: Robert (Japanese: ヒロ  Hiro ) is one of the three Club Members from the Psychic Club , under Club Master  Murray , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Daniel (TCG GB)
lore: Daniel (Japanese: ケイタ  Keita ) is one of the three Club Members from the Psychic Club , under Club Master  Murray , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Murray (TCG GB)
lore: Murray (Japanese: ミウラ  Miura ) is the Club Master of the Psychic Club (Japanese: エスパークラブ  Esper Club ).  He plays using the Strange Psyshock Deck (Japanese: アヤシイねんりきデッキ  Suspicious Confusion Deck ) and gives away the Psychic Medal to challengers who defeat him.  In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the わたされたGRデッキ  Handed Over GR Deck and later the ちょうエリートデッキ  Psychic Elite Deck . Murray is known for his arrogance and for not listening to other people. He also wields a spoon, similar to the spoon Kadabra has.

title: Nicholas (TCG GB)
lore: Nicholas (Japanese: ソウスケ  Sōsuke ) is one of the three Club Members from the Lightning Club , under Club Master  Isaac , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Jennifer (TCG GB)
lore: Jennifer (Japanese: ユカ  Yuka ) is one of the three Club Members from the Lightning Club , under Club Master  Isaac , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Brandon (TCG GB)
lore: Brandon (Japanese: トシヒコ  Toshihiko ) is one of the three Club Members from the Lightning Club , under Club Master  Isaac , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Isaac (TCG GB)
lore: Isaac (Japanese: タカハシ  Takahashi ) is the Club Master of the Lightning Club (Japanese: エレキクラブ  Electric Club ). He plays using the Zapping Selfdestruct Deck (Japanese: じばくでビリビリデッキ  Zap by Selfdestruct Deck ) and gives away the Lightning Medal to challengers who defeat him. In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the スカイスパークデッキ  Sky Spark Deck and later the ビリビリじばくデッキ  Electric Selfdestruct Deck .

title: Sara (TCG GB)
lore: Sara (Japanese: マリ  Mari ) is one of the three Club Members from the Water Club , under Club Master  Amy , in Pokémon Trading Card Game . She is the twin sister of fellow Club Member, Amanda .

title: Joshua (TCG GB)
lore: Joshua (Japanese: シンタロー  Shintarō ) is one of the three Club Members from the Water Club , under Club Master  Amy , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Amanda (TCG GB)
lore: Amanda (Japanese: メグミ  Megumi ) is one of the three Club Members from the Water Club , under Club Master  Amy , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .  She is Sara 's twin sister.

title: Amy (TCG GB)
lore: Amy (Japanese: ウッチー  Utchi ) is the Club Master of the Water Club . She plays using the Rain Dancer Deck and gives away the Water Medal to challengers who defeat her. In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , she uses the Rain Dance Confusion Deck. Her club is a sun-dappled pool where she lounges and naps.

title: Jonathan (TCG GB)
lore: Jonathan (Japanese: マサトシ  Masatoshi ) is one of the three Club Members from the Fire Club , under Club Master  Ken , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: John (TCG GB)
lore: John (Japanese: タカシ  Takashi ) is one of the three Club Members from the Fire Club , under Club Master  Ken , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Adam (TCG GB)
lore: Adam (Japanese: ワタルン  Watarun ) is one of the three Club Members from the Fire Club , under Club Master  Ken , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Ken (TCG GB)
lore: Ken (Japanese: アカバネ  Akabane ) is the Club Master of the Fire Club (Japanese: ファイアクラブ  Fire Club ).  He plays using the Fire Charge Deck (Japanese: ほのおのとっしんデッキ  Fire Take Down Deck ) and gives away the Fire Medal to challengers who defeat him.  In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the ゆけ！ウィンディデッキ  Go! Windie Deck . His club is a colosseum filled with flaming torches.

title: Joseph (TCG GB)
lore: Joseph (Japanese: ソウタ  Sōta ) is one of the three Club Members from the Science Club , under Club Master  Rick , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Erik (TCG GB)
lore: Erik (Japanese: マサシ  Masashi ) is one of the three Club Members from the Science Club , under Club Master  Rick , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: David (TCG GB)
lore: David (Japanese: ヤスユキ  Yasuyuki ) is one of the three Club Members from the Science Club , under Club Master  Rick , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Rick (TCG GB)
lore: Rick (Japanese: クルシマ  Kurushima ) is the Club Master of the Science Club (Japanese: サイエンスクラブ  Science Club ).  He plays using the Wonders of Science Deck (Japanese: かがくのちからだデッキ  Power of Science Deck ) and gives away the Science Medal to challengers who defeat him.  In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , he uses the ダークサイエンスデッキ  Dark Science Deck . His club is a laboratory where he works on strange experiments.

title: Kristin (TCG GB)
lore: Kristin (Japanese: ハルナ  Haruna ) is one of the three Club Members from the Grass Club , under Club Master  Nikki , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Heather (TCG GB)
lore: Heather (Japanese: ミサオ  Misao ) is one of the three Club Members from the Grass Club , under Club Master  Nikki , in Pokémon Trading Card Game

title: Brittany (TCG GB)
lore: Brittany (Japanese: アヤコ  Ayako ) is one of the three Club Members from the Grass Club , under Club Master  Nikki , in Pokémon Trading Card Game .

title: Nikki (TCG GB)
lore: Nikki (Japanese: クニミ  Kunimi ) is the Club Master of the Grass Club (Japanese: グリーンクラブ  Green Club ).  She plays using the Flower Power Deck (Japanese: はなのおてだまデッキ  Flower Juggling Deck ) and gives away the Grass Medal to challengers who defeat her.  In Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! , she uses the ＭＡＸエナジーデッキ  MAX Energy Deck . Her club is a beautiful greenhouse, although she's not in it when the main character first enters it.

title: Aaron (TCG GB)
lore: Aaron (Japanese: あらいモン  Arai Mon ) is one of Dr. Mason 's technicians in the video games Pokémon Trading Card Game and Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! .

title: Sam (TCG GB)
lore: Sam (Japanese: ミカサ  Mikasa ) is one of Dr. Mason 's technicians in the video games Pokémon Trading Card Game and Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! .

title: Dr. Mason
lore: Dr. Mason (Japanese: Ｄｒ．オーヤマ  Dr. Ōyama ) is a Pokémon card researcher. He resides in Mason Laboratory , where he teaches people how to play the Pokémon Trading Card Game and coaches practice duels. He was named and modeled after Pokémon Trading Card Game creator Kouichi Ooyama .

title: Ronald (TCG GB)
lore: Ronald (Japanese: ランド  Lando ) is the rival of Mark and Mint in Pokémon Trading Card Game and Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! . In the second game, he infiltrates Team Great Rocket as the Enigmatic Mask  GRX (Japanese: GRX ).

title: Mom (Kanto)
lore: Mom (Japanese: おかあさん  mother ) is the mother of Red or Leaf depending on the game.

title: Koichi
lore: Koichi (Japanese: タケノリ  Takenori ) is a Black Belt and the leader of the Fighting Dojo in Pokémon FireRed, LeafGreen , Let's Go, Pikachu!, and Let's Go, Eevee! . He is the only character in the games to have the Trainer class  Karate Master (Japanese: からてだいおう  Great Karate King ).

title: Pokémon Center lady
lore: The Pokémon Center lady [ 1 ] (Japanese: ポケモンセンターお 姉 ( ねえ ) さん  Pokémon Center lady ), also known as the Pokémon Center Nurse [ 2 ] or receptionist (Japanese: うけつけのねーちゃん  reception lady ) [ 3 ] , is an operator of a Pokémon Center . They facilitate the restoration of Trainers ' Pokémon to full HP , and usually provide this basic service free of charge. Among fans, the Pokémon Center lady is often mistaken for her counterpart introduced in Pokémon the Series , Nurse Joy . In Pokémon Sun, Moon , Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon , they can be battled at the Battle Tree and Battle Royal Dome under the Trainer class  Pokémon Center Lady (Japanese: ＰＣおねえさん  PC Lady ).

title: Baoba
lore: Baoba (Japanese: バオバ  Baoba ) is a non-player character that first appeared in Pokémon Red and Blue . At that time, he was the owner and warden of the Kanto Safari Zone in Fuchsia City and was known simply as Safari Zone Warden . (Japanese: 園長  Park Head ). He also used to be nicknamed Warden Slowpoke , due to his vacant look. In Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver , it was revealed that the warden had built a new Safari Zone west of Cianwood City .

title: Copycat (character)
lore: Copycat (Japanese: モノマネむすめ  Mimic Girl ) is a girl that lives in Saffron City in the Kanto  region . She collects Pokémon dolls , and likes to dress up as and mimic others. Copycat is not her real name, but rather her nickname.

title: Reina
lore: Reina (Japanese: レイナ  Reina ) is a recurring character in Pokémon Origins and a volunteer at the Lavender Volunteer Pokémon House .

title: Mr. Fuji
lore: Mr. Fuji (Japanese: フジ 老人  Elder Fuji ) is a kind old man who lives in Lavender Town in the Kanto  region . Mr. Fuji used to live on Cinnabar Island , where he was known as Dr. Fuji (Japanese: フジ 博士 ( はかせ )  Dr. Fuji ), the founder of Cinnabar Lab . [ citation needed ]  According to Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS/Wii U , Dr. Fuji discovered Mew . A relation between Mr. Fuji and Mew is also implied in Pokémon Emerald. In some animated works , it is suggested that he is the scientist related to the creation of Mewtwo. This would imply that he is in fact the author of the Pokémon Mansion journals .

title: Bill
lore: Bill (Japanese: ソネザキマサキ  Masaki Sonezaki ) is a Pokémon researcher, widely regarded as an expert in many fields. He has made many appearances in the games. Bill is most commonly found in his Sea Cottage , which is north of Cerulean City at the end of Route 25 . He is most notable for his first appearance in the Generation I games and for his Pokémon Storage System that has been pertinent in the entire animated series .

title: Lance
lore: Lance (Japanese: ワタル  Wataru ) is a Dragon-type  Trainer , a member of the Indigo  Elite Four in Generations  I , III , and VII , and the Pokémon Champion of the Indigo Plateau in Generations II and IV .

title: Agatha
lore: Agatha (Japanese: キクコ  Kikuko ) is a Ghost-type  Trainer who serves as a member of the Indigo  Elite Four in Generations I , III , and VII .

title: Bruno
lore: Bruno (Japanese: シバ  Siba ) is a Fighting-type  Trainer and member of the Indigo  Elite Four .

title: Lorelei
lore: Lorelei (Japanese: カンナ  Kanna ) is an Ice-type  Trainer and member of the Indigo  Elite Four .

title: Giovanni
lore: Giovanni (Japanese: サカキ  Sakaki ) is the head of Team Rocket , who serves as the secretive Gym Leader of Viridian City 's Gym , known officially as the Viridian Gym , in Generation I , Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen , and Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee! . He hands out the Earth Badge to Trainers who defeat him in battle . As a Gym Leader, he specializes in Ground-type  Pokémon , but his master plan includes collecting rare Pokémon of all types . After he disbands Team Rocket and abandons his Gym, his role as the Viridian Gym Leader is taken over by Blue . In Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon , he makes a return appearance as the leader of Team Rainbow Rocket . He is the only character in the games to have the Trainer classes  Boss FR LG / Rocket Boss HG SS / Team Rocket Boss P E (Japanese: ロケットだんボス  Team Rocket Boss ) and Team Rainbow Rocket (Japanese: Rロケットだん  Team R Rocket ).

title: Blaine
lore: Blaine (Japanese: カツラ  Katsura ) is the Gym Leader of Cinnabar Island 's (later the Seafoam Islands ') Gym , known officially as the Cinnabar Gym . He hands out the Volcano Badge to Trainers who defeat him in battle . He is a highly intelligent man who specializes in Fire-type  Pokémon .

title: Sabrina
lore: Sabrina (Japanese: ナツメ  Natsume ) is the Gym Leader of Saffron City 's Gym , known officially as the Saffron Gym . She hands out the Marsh Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle . She possesses psychic abilities and specializes in Psychic-type  Pokémon .

title: Koga
lore: Koga (Japanese: キョウ  Kyou ) is the former Gym Leader of Fuchsia City 's Gym . He is a student of ninjutsu who specializes in Poison-type  Pokémon . He handed out the Soul Badge to Trainers who defeated him in battle . He became a member of the Indigo  Elite Four some time after the events of Generation I and its remakes, but before the events of Generation II and its remakes, thus leaving his daughter Janine in charge of the Fuchsia Gym .

title: Erika
lore: Erika (Japanese: エリカ  Erika ) is the Gym Leader of Celadon City 's Gym , known officially as the Celadon Gym . She hands out the Rainbow Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle . She is a serene young woman who specializes in Grass-type  Pokémon . She is always dressed in an elegant kimono , and seems to represent traditional Japanese beauty.

title: Lt. Surge
lore: Lt. Surge (Japanese: マチス  Matisse [ 5 ] ) is the Gym Leader of Vermilion City 's Gym , known officially as the Vermilion Gym . He hands out the Thunder Badge to Trainers who defeat him in battle . He specializes in Electric-type  Pokémon .

title: Misty
lore: Misty (Japanese: カスミ  Kasumi ) is the Gym Leader of Cerulean City 's Gym , known officially as the Cerulean Gym . She gives the Cascade Badge to Trainers who defeat her in battle . She specializes in Water-type  Pokémon .

title: Brock
lore: Brock (Japanese: タケシ  Takeshi ) is the Gym Leader of Pewter City 's Gym , known officially as the Pewter Gym . He gives the Boulder Badge to Trainers who defeat him in battle . He specializes in Rock-type  Pokémon .

title: Daisy Oak
lore: Daisy Oak (Japanese: ナナミ  Nanami ) is the older sister of Blue and granddaughter of Professor Oak . She is also known as May (Japanese: サツキ  Satsuki ) in The Electric Tale of Pikachu manga.

title: Professor Oak
lore: Professor Samuel Oak (Japanese: オーキド・ユキナリ博士  Dr. Yukinari Ohkido ) is a Pokémon Professor who lives and works at his research lab in Pallet Town of the Kanto  region .

title: Blue (game)
lore: Blue Oak (Japanese: グリーン  Green ) is the rival of the player in the Generation I games, as well as in Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen , their Generation III  remakes . By the end of the main game in these games, he also becomes the Pokémon Champion of the Indigo Plateau . Sometime during the three years between the plotline of the Generation I games, Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen, and the events of the Generation II games and their remakes, Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver , as well as during the events of Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee! , Blue takes the place of Giovanni as the Viridian City  Gym Leader , as Giovanni had disappeared after he disbanded Team Rocket . Blue does not specialize in a particular type of Pokémon and, like Giovanni before him, he gives anyone who defeats him an Earth Badge . In Pokémon Sun, Moon , Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon , he is one of the leaders of Alola 's Battle Tree , the other being Red .
